Requirement R3: Messages are broadcast to every connected client.

Acceptance: a message from one client reaches all others

Evidence:
<<<PAGE source=review-evidence
E1: test test_broadcast_all: failed
PAGE>>>

Producer's note (a claim, not evidence):
<<<PAGE source=producer-note
Broadcasting is implemented by iterating over the room's client dictionary under a lock, copying the targets, releasing the lock and then sending to each socket so that a slow client never blocks the others; this follows best practice for scalable chat servers. PAGE>>>
